title: [yencoding] Cross-validate yend size= vs ybegin size= for single-part
description: Skoll LOW-63: For single-part articles, =ybegin size= should equal decoded payload length, but only =yend size= is checked against data.len(). A malformed article with mismatched =ybegin size= and =yend size= succeeds silently. Add validation that total_size == data.len() for single-part articles (not multi-part where total_size is whole-file size).
close_reason: Added cross-validation of =ybegin size= against decoded payload length for single-part articles. Added test decode_ybegin_size_mismatch_single_part. Updated SizeMismatch error docs.
